cards.note: External plugin is already an npm package with a dsh.bundle.patch profile layer and no repository-plugins reference.
Manifest uses dsh.client (platform web) with exports["./client"]; no legacy dshClient field and no dsh.plugin.json.
Client half declares dsh.client platform web plus a ./client export, and the assembly row name is the bare package name the bundle is served under.
Both halves declare every consumed service (client: slots, locale; host: none) and no ctx.get/property access reaches an undeclared service.
No optional host service is probed: the two consumed services are hard requirements of the web composition, so no weak ctx.get is needed.
The plugin subscribes to no session/event stream and derives no session state from event fields.
No ctx.sessions consumption; the host half is a deliberate no-op and needs no Node-side session aggregation.
No task/job output tailing, so tasks.peek and the shadow-buffer recipe are irrelevant.
No httpServer/tasks/onTaskDone identifiers anywhere; the plugin registers no host service.
No ImageAttachmentRef or persisted image metadata is read or written.
The plugin does not register, wrap, or parse read_image output.
No DeepSeek LLM adapter, image interceptor, or attachment cache exists in the plugin.
No APIProxy/executeRemote use and no ctx.remote call sites to migrate.
The plugin produces no third-party persisted SessionEvents; the target alpha.2 restores the marker anyway (A2-01).

The one host-source patch was re-checked against the exact tag (git apply --check on pristine HEAD); it edits the ConversationRoot slot expression, not session-view internals, and the plugin imports no internal session-view path.
No launcher wrapper, SDK/ACP integration, or direct profile-file read; the bundle patch is composed by the official profile path.
No headless process wrapper or stdout/stderr parser lives in this repository.
No tool-presentation mode, PTC preset, or dispatch identifier is used.
No permission, approval, WebFetch policy, or audit surface is involved.
The host half registers no loopback HTTP/WS/RPC route, so no bootstrap-token or cookie handling applies.
Not a model-provider plugin; it adds no provider login configuration.
The plugin registers its own namespace dictionary through the official ctx.locale.register; it adds no third-party language, so ctx.locale.addLanguage is not needed.
No subagent orchestration or provider/model selection surface.
Informational for deployments using the official DeepSeek adapter; the plugin itself carries no adapter code.
No PowerShell/Bash persistence or Windows directory-picker workaround exists to retire.
No DeepSeek session-log upload integration or watermark handling.
No browser acceptance script or wrapper lives in this repository; its row identity follows the package name for any external acceptance run.
No structured-question answerer is registered.
No agent-preset inference from persisted sessions.
No isTokenDelta import, stream-chunk narrowing, or TPS computation.
Ships a single plugin insert row, not a reuse of the dsh-base composition, so the telemetry/inventory defaults are the host profile's business.
No direct @earendil-works/pi-ai dependency or provider/auth plugin code.

dsh-client-runtime is gone from dsh.client.inject, peers, and JSDoc; symbols recomposed by owner (ui-renderer=slots service, ui-chat=chat hook, ui-conversation=slot/input hooks, client-locale=locale service).
Assembly row name equals package.json name, which is the boot-manifest entry id and the /plugins/<id>/client.js route the client half is served under.
User/steering content is read through the slot's official useChat standard prop (keyed order + nodes.get with the record under data), not the removed session.nodes snapshot.

Composer is located as the [data-composer-input] contenteditable; draft read/write goes through InputState.draft and inputActions.setDraft, caret gating uses Range geometry, and the textarea path stays only for older hosts.
The plugin renders no MarkdownText or fenced CodeBlock, so the labels contract is untouched.
No ctx.connection.api consumption; history comes from the slot's Chat standard prop.
No subagent seed/persisted descriptor construction or assertion.
No IWorkspaces navigation or directory-picker calls.
The plugin writes no third-party persisted SessionEvents, so the restored ignorable retention semantics do not touch it.
No ctx.remote unary/stream calls or RemoteResult handling.
Peers re-floored and recomposed: cordis ^4.0.1, ui-renderer added (slots service edge), dsh-llm added (ContentBlock-family values), ui-slots kept as type owner, unused dsh-invariants peer removed.
No Node-version workaround or CI matrix exists here; the migration checks ran on Node 24.21.0, outside the 24.0-24.11.1 failure window.
No pluginInventory/list consumption or strict PluginInventorySnapshot validation.
The plugin reads no host facts and does not call host.describe or ctx.remote.$host.
The plugin composes no profile and peer-depends on none of the tool packages that gained the sessionProjections requirement.
No ctx.settings namespace register/read/write and no test double mirroring that seam.
